title: DATEVALUE ( "1/8/2009" ) is January 8, 2009 in en-US: month first

source.quote: If the model date/time settings represent dates in the format of Month/Day/Year, then the string, "1/8/2009", is converted to a datetime value equivalent to January 8th of 2009.
source.supports: the rule for a month/day/year culture

derivation: The model culture is en-US, whose dates are month/day/year, so "1/8/2009" is January 8, 2009.
